active.description: The active status of the authentication provider

name.description: The name associated with the authentication provider.

settings.description: The settings associated with the authentication provider.

idp_cert_fingerprint.description: The certificate fingerprint for the identity provider (IdP)

idp_cert_fingerprint_algorithm.description: The algorithm used to generate the identity provider's (IdP) certificate fingerprint

idp_entity_id.description: The Entity ID for the identity provider (IdP).

idp_sso_target_url.description: The SSO target url for the identity provider (IdP).

settings_url.description: The URL for the identity provider metadata file to populate the settings automatically. If the settings attribute is provided, that will be used instead.

short_name.description: The short name associated with the authentication provider. This must be unique and URL-friendly, as it's going to be part of the login URL.
